A 0/1 lattice homomorphism q separating m and M and p=q-1 form an admissible pair with |q(x)|+|p(x)|=1, while the strong unit takes value one on both; hence its free norm is at least two and the upper bound makes it exactly two. The trivial one-point lattice is correctly excluded.
